_note: It listens on loopback; put the same TLS reverse proxy as the request API in front of it for anyone else.
tokens: the request API's tokens file. Observers get named tokens with the operator scope, e.g.
python -m robofast_core.request_api tokens add --config request_api.json --name alice --scope read,operator,submit,too
enclosures: each enclosure's config (shared with its supervisor and sequencer) and, when the sequencer
runs with --plan, that plan file. Give the enclosure config a status_file (the telescopes' state) and an
operator_control directory (pause, resume and stop); without them the console shows less and can only
stop the whole enclosure. spectrograph: the KiwiSpec service (deploy/kiwispec.example.json listens on 8130).
emergency_close: the token file (mode 600) for the dome server's close-only channel, used when the supervisor
does not answer within 2 s; fallback 'dome' closes without waiting for the telescopes to park (docs/console.md).
